title: 第26章 胆敢进入南落一步者，死
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“嗯，我知道的，老祖别担心，璃月会解决。”

    李归鸿依旧一副丝毫不在乎的模样，仿佛已经肯定南落帝国周边聚集的这些大佬打不过小徒弟。

    直将老祖看得火冒三丈，有他这么当人师父的吗？

    “李归鸿，你能不能有点做人家师父的……”

    “样子”二字未曾出口，一股极其恐怖的威压自异象残留地中央迅速蔓延开来。

    紧随其后的是一道极其清冷的女声：“胆敢进入南落城一步者，死！”

    最后那个“死”字，带着超越渡劫巅峰的力量，传入现场每一个老怪物耳中。

    太虚宗老祖甚至都不敢有丝毫反抗，立即臣服于这股强大的威压。

    他生怕自己晚一步，就被这股恐怖的威压碾成粉尘。

    早已躺平臣服的李归鸿：……

    不是早就说了，这些人干不过他小徒弟，老祖都是白担心，他们俩好好躺平就行。

    南落城外某个地方，匆匆赶来的某位宗门老祖带着后辈们跪了一地，连连认错：

    “抱歉大人，我等无意冒犯，还望大人饶恕，我们这就速速离开。”

    相似的场景在南落城外各个地方上演，老祖们现在快后悔死了。

    要早知道这异象是实力超越渡劫巅峰的大佬弄出来的，他们也不会如此贸然赶过来，差点葬送了自己的性命。

    现在只求这位大人是个好脾气的，能饶恕他们打扰的罪过。不然光凭这股威压的气势，就能让他们一行人葬送在这里。

    众人对着虚空道歉过后，气氛凝滞许久，却无一人敢说话，只因那威压还高悬在他们头顶，像是一把随时会落下的利剑。

    冷汗从两侧额鬓浸出，裴峰望向南落主城方向，第一次生出后怕。

    他目前已是渡劫初期，面对这股慑人的威压时，却连反抗的念头都不敢有。

    对方的实力，根本就不是他能够想象的。
content_en:
"Well, I know. Don't worry, ancestor, Liyue will take care of it."

Li Guihong still looked unconcerned, as if he was sure that the big guys gathered around the Nanluo Empire could not defeat his young apprentice.

The ancestor was so furious at the sight of him, could he be such a master?

"Li Guihong, can you be a bit of a master..."

Before the word "appearance" was uttered, an extremely terrifying pressure spread rapidly from the center of the place where the vision remained.

Following closely was an extremely cold female voice: "Anyone who dares to enter Nanluo City will die!"

The last word "death", with a power beyond the peak of tribulation, reached the ears of every old monster present.

The ancestor of Taixu Sect did not even dare to resist at all, and immediately surrendered to this powerful pressure.

He was afraid that if he was too late, he would be crushed into dust by this terrifying pressure.

Li Guihong, who had already laid down and surrendered:...

Didn't I say it a long time ago that these people can't defeat his young apprentice? The ancestor is worried for nothing, they just need to lie down flat.

Somewhere outside Nanluo City, a certain ancestor of the sect who hurried over kneeled on the ground with his juniors, admitting their mistakes again and again:

"I'm sorry, sir. I didn't mean to offend you. I hope you will forgive me. We will leave quickly."

Similar scenes were staged in various places outside Nanluo City. The ancestors are now regretting it to death.

If they had known earlier that this strange phenomenon was caused by a boss whose strength was beyond the peak of transcending tribulation, they would not have rushed over so rashly and almost lost their lives.

Now I just hope that this gentleman has a good temper and can forgive them for disturbing them.Otherwise, just with this coercive momentum, their group could be buried here.

After everyone apologized to the void, the atmosphere was stagnant for a long time, but no one dared to speak, because the pressure was still hanging high above their heads, like a sharp sword that could fall at any time.

Cold sweat dripped from both sides of his temples. Pei Feng looked towards the direction of Nanluo Main City and felt fear for the first time.

He was currently in the early stages of transcending the tribulation, but when faced with this terrifying pressure, he didn't even dare to think of resisting.

The opponent's strength was simply beyond his imagination.
title_en: Chapter 26 Anyone who dares to take a step south will die.
